rules: 이전 상품 구매 없이 공개된 디자인을 선택 가능
유료 외형은 요리·수익·성장에 혜택을 주지 않음
구매한 디자인은 추가 결제 없이 다시 적용
상품 이미지 제작 및 검토 후 등록하며 미제작 디자인을 완성품으로 표시하지 않음

growthStages.label: 소박하고 아늑한 시작
growthStages.budget: ONE small paper pendant at most, old plain matte timber and a few ordinary bowls, only one small vase/planter, no brass trim, no decorative panels, no new showroom. Clean aged ivory fridge, natural age without grime. Improvements must remain small and affordable-looking.

growthStages.label: 정갈하게 가꾼 단골집
growthStages.budget: TWO small paper lamps at most; repaired plain matte counter, clean ivory vintage fridge, neatly repaired cream plaster, organized everyday ceramics in existing shelves, simple cleaned joinery. No gold/brass outlines or fancy motifs. A very modest cared-for neighborhood shop.

growthStages.label: 재료와 마감의 깊이
growthStages.budget: TWO or THREE SMALL crafted washi lamps, visibly better quality MATTE oak/walnut counter, clean refurbished ivory fridge, smooth cream plaster, crafted wood joints and organized shelves, very restrained ceramics. No gilded wall lines, no patterned luxury panels; still intimate and quiet.

growthStages.label: 작고 깊은 멋의 완성
growthStages.budget: THREE SMALL handmade paper lamps; excellent MATTE walnut joinery and counter, perfect cream plaster and cabinetry, refurbished clean cream or deep olive vintage fridge, tiny brass handles/contact fittings only, few refined ceramics. Quality improves across walls, fridge and storage as well as the counter. No illuminated display niche, shiny gold lines or lavish decorative abundance. Quiet boutique craftsmanship in the SAME small diner.
